title: Min Cost to Connect All Points
description: Given points on a 2D plane, return the minimum total cost to connect all points, where connecting two points costs their Manhattan distance.

reference.use_case: Connecting a set of sites with the least total cable, pipe, or road length so every site is reachable.
system_examples: Network and utility planning — laying fiber, power lines, or pipes between sites at minimum total cost
Single-linkage hierarchical clustering — merges clusters in the same order as connecting points by cheapest links
VLSI/PCB design — estimating minimum wiring length between pins
reference.explanation: This is a minimum spanning tree: Prim's algorithm (O(n²) suits this dense complete graph) or Kruskal's with union-find repeatedly adds the cheapest edge that doesn't form a cycle. MSTs appear in infrastructure planning, network design, and clustering.
